title: Earn cleanly and keep the hand open
summary: Let service become care that steadies both hand and heart. Keep this close: Carry this with you: honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Honest labor and open-handed giving reveal a truer path.
source.lifeApplication: When money hardens into accumulation, interrupt it with one deliberate gift.
